mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_compensation_record (compensation_action,order_number,user_id,coupon_id,first_reason,last_reason,evidence_mask, status,attempt_count,next_retry_at,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES ('RELEASE_RESERVATION',#{orderNumber},#{userId},#{couponId},LEFT(#{reason},32),LEFT(#{reason},32), #{evidenceMask},'PENDING',0,NOW(3),0,NOW(3),NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evidence_mask=IF(user_id=VALUES(user_id) AND coupon_id=VALUES(coupon_id), (evidence_mask | VALUES(evidence_mask)),evidence_mask), last_reason=IF(user_id=VALUES(user_id) AND coupon_id=VALUES(coupon_id), VALUES(last_reason),last_reason), status=IF(user_id=VALUES(user_id) AND coupon_id=VALUES(coupon_id),status,'MANUAL_REQUIRED'), last_error=IF(user_id=VALUES(user_id) AND coupon_id=VALUES(coupon_id),last_error, 'compensation identity conflict'), updated_at=NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_compensation_record SET status=#{status},last_result=#{status},last_error=#{lastError}, redis_applied_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='SUCCEEDED' THEN NOW(3) ELSE redis_applied_at END, completed_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='SUCCEEDED' THEN NOW(3) ELSE completed_at END, next_retry_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='RETRY_PENDING' THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 5 SECOND) ELSE NULL END, locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='IN_PROGRESS' AND locked_by=#{worker}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM seckill_compensation_record WHERE compensation_action='RELEASE_RESERVATION' AND order_number=#{orderNumber}
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_compensation_record SET status='MANUAL_REQUIRED',last_result='MANUAL_REQUIRED', last_error='compensation identity conflict',next_retry_at=NULL, locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE compensation_action='RELEASE_RESERVATION' AND order_number=#{orderNumber} AND (user_id<>#{userId} OR coupon_id<>#{couponId})

UPDATE seckill_compensation_record SET status='MANUAL_REQUIRED',last_result='MANUAL_REQUIRED',last_error=#{lastError}, next_retry_at=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL, version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='IN_PROGRESS' AND locked_by=#{worker}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM seckill_compensation_record WHERE attempt_count<10 AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=NOW(3))) OR (status='IN_PROGRESS' AND locked_until<NOW(3))) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_at,created_at),id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_compensation_record SET status='IN_PROGRESS',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,locked_by=#{worker}, locked_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 30 SECOND),version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND attempt_count<10 AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=NOW(3))) OR (status='IN_PROGRESS' AND locked_until<NOW(3)))

UPDATE seckill_compensation_record SET status='IN_PROGRESS',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,locked_by=#{worker}, locked_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 30 SECOND),version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE compensation_action='RELEASE_RESERVATION' AND order_number=#{orderNumber} AND attempt_count<10 AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=NOW(3))) OR (status='IN_PROGRESS' AND locked_until<NOW(3)))

UPDATE seckill_compensation_record SET status='MANUAL_REQUIRED',next_retry_at=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL, last_result='MANUAL_REQUIRED',last_error='compensation attempts exhausted', version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE attempt_count>=#{maxAttempts} AND (status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING') OR (status='IN_PROGRESS' AND locked_until<NOW(3))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seckill_compensation_record WHERE compensation_action='RELEASE_RESERVATION' AND order_number=#{orderNumber} AND (evidence_mask & 4)=4
